description: This file contains unit tests for the JwtAuthenticationProvider class, verifying its behavior in handling JWT authentication within the security framework of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing JwtAuthenticationProvider's functionality, including applicability checks and authentication processing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, including creating mock headers and the provider under test.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Tests whether JwtAuthenticationProvider correctly identifies requests with valid authorization headers.

methods.name: isApplicableWithoutAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the provider correctly reports non-applicability when no authorization header is present.

methods.name: isApplicableWithInvalidAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Checks that invalid authorization headers cause the provider to report non-applicability.

methods.name: doExtractAuthentication
methods.description: Tests successful extraction and validation of JWT and creation of authentication results.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationWhenAuthorizationContextProviderErrors
methods.description: Ensures that exceptions during context provisioning are handled as authentication failures.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationWithMissingJwt
methods.description: Checks handling of requests missing a JWT token.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationWithInvalidJwt
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid JWT tokens during validation.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResultExtractsDittoRuntimeExceptionFromCause
methods.description: Verifies proper extraction of underlying exceptions when converting failure causes.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Tests creation of failed authentication results from exceptions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Verifies that the provider reports JWT as the authorization context type.

methods.name: mockRequestContext
methods.description: Utility method for creating mock RequestContext objects with optional headers.
